title: Oven-Roasted Moroccan Chickpea Bissara
description: A charred, velvety Moroccan chickpea dish featuring a rich mother sauce base, made with heavy cream and egg-free ingredients. This show-stopping bissara is perfect for a dinner party.
instructions: Rinse and drain the chickpeas, then place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chickpeas and toss to coat.
Roast the chickpeas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they're golden brown and slightly charred.
While the chickpeas are roasting, heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's softened and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, pumpkin puree, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and reduced slightly.
Remove the roasted chickpeas from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Add the chickpeas to the saucepan with the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Using an immersion blender, puree the mixture until smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook over low heat until the sauce has thickened and the cream has melted.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the bissara hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
